newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil hires new Oil And Gas chief.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil hires new Oil And Gas chief.

text.p: Pennzoil Co said Tuesday Stephen D. Chesebro' is joining the company as an executive vice president and president of Pennzoil Exploration and Production Co with responsibility for Pennzoil's oil and gas business segment.

In addition, the company said, Donald A. Frederick will beeome executive vice president of Pennzoil Exploration February 20. Frederick will report to Chesebro' and will be responsible for Pennzoil's day-to-day exploration and production operations worldwide.

Chesebro', 55, joins Pennzoil after serving as the head of Tenneco Energy which was acquired by El Paso Energy Corp. Frederick, 51, was the senior vice president of exploration for Transworld Exploration and Production Inc.
